title: 1945 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship

{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1945 | image = | dates = | teams = | connacht = | munster = Tipperary | leinster = Kilkenny | ulster = | matches = | poty = | team = Tipperary | titles = 13th | captain = [[John Maher (Tipperary hurler)|John Maher]] | manager = | team2 = Kilkenny | captain2 = [[Peter Blanchfield]] | manager2 = | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = [[Jim Langton]] (0–28) | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1944|1944]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1946|1946]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1945''' was the 59th series of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the championship, beating [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] 5–6 to 3–6 in the [[1945 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]].{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=20 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }} ==Format== The All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship was run on a provincial basis as usual. All games were played on a knockout basis whereby once a team lost they were eliminated from the championship. The format for the All-Ireland series of games ran as follows: * The winners of the [[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship|Leinster Championship]] advanced directly to the first All-Ireland semi-final. * [[Galway GAA|Galway]], a team who faced no competition in the [[Connacht Senior Hurling Championship|Connacht Championship]], entered the championship at the All-Ireland semi-final stage where they played the Leinster winners. * The winners of the [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship|Munster Championship]] advanced directly to the second All-Ireland semi-final. * The winners of the [[Ulster Senior Hurling Championship|Ulster Championship]] advanced directly to the second All-Ireland semi-final where they played the Munster champions. ==Provincial championships== ===[[Leinster
